source_documents.title: Rational Design of Red AIEgens with New Core Structure from Non-Emissive Heteroaromatics

reference_evidence_units.quote: TAA-4PTPA exhibited faint but much redder emission at ca. 708 nm in THF.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF; 10 micromolar, excitation 474 nm from Figure 2 caption.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target shows weak approximately 708 nm emission in THF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not TAA-4TPA's 627 nm or TAA-4P's blue emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A strong emission band at 641 nm was recorded with fw started from 30%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target aggregate-related emission rises near 641 nm from about 30% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Water-fraction threshold and emission differ from comparator TAA-4TPA.

reference_evidence_units.quote: at high fw from 60% to 90%, macroscopic aggregates were formed immediately and floated on the surface of solvent
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: Macroscopic floating aggregates prevent reliable fluorimeter spectra at high water fraction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not invent target spectra or yields for 60-90% water from the comparator's curves.

reference_evidence_units.quote: whereas, in TAA-4PTPA, CT transition became dominant.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source finds stronger CT-dominated character than the LE/CT mixed TAA-4TPA comparator.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Orbital-based interpretation is computational, not a direct charge-transfer yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TAA-4PTPA allowed it to relax to twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) state easily by molecular motion upon excitation
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of flexibility, S1/S0 calculations and 234 nm Stokes shift.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign red solution emission and energy dissipation to motion-enabled TICT relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No explicit target TICT barrier is given; TAA-4P reorganization-energy calculations are not transferred.

reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Rates estimated from measured quantum yield and lifetime in THF.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reported target knr is 6.23e8 s-1 and kr is 0.06e8 s-1, versus comparator 2.49e8 and 0.61e8.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Derived rates, not new inference experiments or direct rate measurements; rounding gives approximate yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, in the solid, the motion of TAA-4PTPA was better restricted.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke steric restriction of motion and reduced structural relaxation to explain brighter solid emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Quantitative reorganization-energy partitioning on p.4 concerns TAA-4P only.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TAA-4PTPA showed higher ΦF of 8.0% than TAA-4TPA in the solid state
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main text reporting SI Table S1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target yield is 8.0% solid versus 1% solution as stated in the same discussion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI table not inspected; do not use comparator TAA-4P's 3.5% crystal yield.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The NPs showed obvious red emission peaked at 615 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAA-4PTPA encapsulated in DSPE-PEG2000
reference_evidence_units.statement: NP emission peaks at 615 nm; reported TEM diameter about 75 nm and DLS about 96 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Distinct formulated condition, not the 641 nm THF/water suspension or proof of cavity binding.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit motion-enabled quenching and restricted solid-state relaxation form the source's AIE explanation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Solid steric constraints and formulated nanoparticles supply an environment for restricted relaxation; no crystal-specific target packing is inferred.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: CT-dominated/TICT relaxation is specifically assigned to target, unlike the more rigid TAA-4TPA comparator.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source-derived radiative/nonradiative rates quantify the weak solution emission; interpretation overlaps with TICT and motion.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit motion-enabled quenching and restricted solid-state relaxation form the source's AIE explanation.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Solid steric constraints and formulated nanoparticles supply an environment for restricted relaxation; no crystal-specific target packing is inferred.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: CT-dominated/TICT relaxation is specifically assigned to target, unlike the more rigid TAA-4TPA comparator.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source-derived radiative/nonradiative rates quantify the weak solution emission; interpretation overlaps with TICT and motion.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
